pivot_note: the bun (old rig's spine pivot); the same pivot as every girl sheet
draw_order: draw order: lower, upper (torso + left arm), arm_right_<state> (the flashlight is drawn over its arm), head (a girl_head_poses frame at head_offset, or girl_sprint_head)
plays_over: girl_pray_loop_lower only (she is still: kneeling never plays over another lower)
pray_rules: Beti PRAY RULES: hands joined palm to palm in front of her chest, just ahead of the head; in off and on the torch is pinched between them pointing at the floor ahead (one look for both); in none the hands are joined with no torch; kneel boots option B.
next_clips_note: bead step / finish / abort start from the loop frames (calm frame 0 = the settle)
clip_note: calm prayer: a slow 1 px breath (held / inhale: shoulders and head back 1 / exhale: shoulders and chest 1 forward / sink: the head follows 1 px late). Frame 0 is the kneel's settle frame exactly (0 px), so girl_pray_kneel -> pray_loop_calm never pops.
light_note: off and on draw the same torch pinched between the joined palms (lens px and switch nub), pointing at the floor ahead; flashlight_tip is at the lens, flashlight_angle_deg the drawn value (deg out from straight ahead). In on the game's beam lights the floor ahead of her.
